ideas.pitch: An enterprise agent that fights wrongful health insurance claim denials by automatically auditing patient medical records against the insurer's exact policy documents.
ideas.title: VeriClaim AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets business viability and scalability as well as technical implementation by solving a painful, high-stakes corporate and consumer finance problem, mirroring the winning strategy of Overturn.

ideas.pitch: An interactive clinical simulation platform for medical students featuring an AI patient evaluated on a 6-dimension rubric and camera-based pose tracking for procedural skills.
ideas.title: MediTrain OSCE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision and LLMs to create a highly demonstrable, interactive product that impresses judges on Innovation and Creativity while fitting the HealthTech track.

ideas.pitch: A supply chain transparency platform that tracks Scope 3 carbon emissions and instantly generates auditable sustainability compliance reports for local manufacturers.
ideas.title: SustainChain Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the SustainTech track with clear, quantifiable economic and environmental impact, scoring high on Business Viability & Scalability.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven accessibility and learning platform designed to detect dyslexia patterns in students and automatically re-format complex academic texts into accessible formats.
ideas.title: EduAdaptive Portal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the EdTech track by solving a genuine accessibility pain point with clear social impact and straightforward, robust technical execution.

ideas.pitch: An automated procurement and vendor compliance auditor for municipal government contracts that cross-references public spending data with regulatory frameworks.
ideas.title: GovFlow Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets Smart Governance with a clear business-to-government model that directly appeals to judges looking for high economic relevance and scalability.
